title: ProductResult
description: 200 of POST /api/library/product (contract §2.11): what the product page says. It adds nothing. Every key is always present.

url.description: The page's final URL after redirects (a pasted page: the address it gives), without user:password@ or #fragment.

category.description: One plain word or two, or null.

dims_candidates.description: Every distinct size reading, best first.

variants.description: The shop's size options when it has more than one; the size the link names first.

dims_index.description: Index into dims_candidates; null when the label couldn't be read.

images.description: The product's pictures (links only: the server never downloads them), product first.

source_layers_used.description: The layers that gave something, in this order; llm only when the model was called.

cost_usd.description: What the language model cost (0 without it).

mock.description: True only when the model was called in mock mode.

candidate.title: DimsCandidate
candidate.description: One size reading, in cm rounded to 0.1.

h.description: Null when the page has no height (never for a rug: its thickness, 1 cm when the page has none). v1 reads a rug's thickness from 0.1 cm.

unit_note.description: How it was converted when the page's unit wasn't cm.

quote.description: The text, structured value or feed text the numbers came from.
